scientific_intent: Test whether public passive triplets can determine whether an upstream X causes terminal Z through mediator Y, and whether a fixed equal intervention budget makes the two hypotheses identifiable. This is an information sufficiency gate, not a learned cognitive architecture evaluation.
prior_negatives: Q15 one-state linear memory DEV NO-GO vs trained Bayes
Q16 learned surprise/reliability write gate DEV NO-GO vs fully fitted cue-aware Bayes
Earlier LCRM O3/O6 causal-path representation and latent entity-port nonidentifiability negatives preserved
Q14 original MiniGrid/Pycolab reset historical custody NO-GO

hypotheses.forward: X~Ber(1/2); Y=X xor Ber(p); Z=Y xor Ber(q); edges X->Y->Z
hypotheses.reverse: Y~Ber(1/2); X=Y xor Ber(p); Z=Y xor Ber(q); edges Y->X and Y->Z
hypotheses.observational: Only passive X,Y,Z samples, with equal a-priori P(H=forward)=P(H=reverse)=1/2. Both models induce exactly the same probability mass on every one of 8 passive triplets.
hypotheses.intervention: Authorized, purely synthetic, known do(X=a) intervention replaces X structural equation while leaving other equations fixed, and reveals only terminal Z. For n=64 total observations: exactly 32 do(X=0), 32 do(X=1); successes are Z==a.
hypotheses.answer: Predict causal direction H (forward vs reverse), not a latent sample label. Under forward intervention success probability r=(1-p)(1-q)+pq; under reverse r=1/2.

evaluation.observation_triplets: Exhaustively enumerate all 8 using exact rational probabilities; do not draw finite passive samples since population distributions are identical
evaluation.intervention: Compute exact finite-n binomial likelihoods for full count k=0..64; no stochastic draws or oracle labels
baselines: Uninformed passive-only optimal Bayesian classifier with 1/2 priors must have expected error exactly 1/2 and mutual information exactly 0 bits.
Equally informed oracle-form Bayesian likelihood-ratio classifier given the two candidate causal structure distributions, same p and q and intervention evidence.

Independent exact enumerative symbolic forward model derives P(Z|do X) by structural equation enumeration from same p and q; must agree with closed-form Bayes probabilities. No weaker controls or asymmetric evidence.
evaluation.resource_accounting: Measure CPU process time and tracemalloc peak for exact proof execution and report; results do not establish CPU or memory advantage versus learned models.
evaluation.decision: If both development families satisfy all exact inequalities, record INFORMATION_SUFFICIENT_FOR_FUTURE_LEARNING_DESIGN_ONLY, never a trained learning-method or scientific success. Otherwise INFORMATION_NO_GO. No held family generation under either outcome.
